summary: The audit checks the preparatory coursework (CSRE 100 and one CCSRE core course, each with a C- or better) and the three honors seminars, CSRE 201X, 201Y and 201Z, at 5 units each. You check by hand the application GPA (3.7 in your major and 3.5 overall), the project proposal your faculty advisor reviews, and the B+ or better grade your thesis needs for honors.

JUjRGTnD.why: "CSRE honors students must enroll in CSRE 201X in the fall, 201Y in the winter, and 201Z in the spring, each of which must be taken for 5 units."
